responsibility: Implements SSA-based conditional constant propagation and related constant-folding passes on GIMPLE. It defines the CCP lattice and statement/PHI simulation on top of the generic SSA propagation engine, propagates executable-edge information to fold conditionals and PHIs, substitutes discovered constants back into the IL, and also hosts companion post-propagation passes such as builtin simplification/folding and post-IPA nonnull diagnostics that leverage the same constant information and CFG cleanup hooks.
same_name_distinction: This is the implementation and pass-definition file for SSA CCP and related follow-on passes, containing the lattice simulation, propagation over statements/PHIs, substitution, CFG cleanup, builtin folding, and post-IPA warnings. In contrast, gcc/tree-ssa-ccp.h is only a small helper header for bit-value transfer routines used by CCP reasoning.
